g.text: xt chat with liaison (claude) · pane input recorded (prompt hook and session log)
I'd like a short digest of what the team shipped each week, ready on Friday morning.
Here is the goal as I'd send it to the lead:
Outcome: every Friday by 09:00, digests/<year>-<week>.md lists the week's merged work, one line
Done when: the first digest is written and the weekly schedule is approved.
08:06 to lead: goal #7 Weekly digest of merged work, every Friday by 09:00
Dispatched to the lead as goal #7. I'll tell you when it's done.
The lead has a plan for the digest and one choice for you: how it gets written each week.
1. Wake the writer every Friday at 07:00 — the digest is ready before 09:00; one billed turn a week
2. Write it only when you ask — no schedule and no cost until you ask; you have to remember
Other: answer in your own words.
⚑ waits for your answer: tab picks it
ype a message and press enter
enter send · tab answer (1) · ↑↓ pick · ctrl+t goals · pgup/pgdn scroll · ctrl+d leave
